aria-label.zh-CN: 按钮的可访问名称；未传且没有 children 时取语言包中的「回到顶部」。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the button. Without it and without children, the locale's 'Back to top' is used.

children.zh-CN: 按钮内的静态内容，传入时代替 `icon` 显示。不能包含链接、按钮、输入框等可交互元素，开发环境下检测到会警告。
children.en-US: Static content of the button, shown in place of `icon` when passed. It must not contain interactive elements such as links, buttons or inputs; a warning is logged in development when it does.

className.zh-CN: 类名，与组件自身的类名合并后落在 `<button>` 上。
className.en-US: Class name, merged with the component's own class name on the `<button>`.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩按钮，同 FloatButton；未设置时为 `false`。
colorful.en-US: Colorful button, same as FloatButton; `false` when unset.

duration.zh-CN: 滚动到顶部所需的毫秒数；点击事件按此间隔节流。
duration.en-US: Milliseconds the scroll to the top takes. The click event is throttled by this interval.

icon.zh-CN: 按钮图标，传入元素；未设置时为 IconBackTop。
icon.en-US: Button icon, passed as an element. Defaults to IconBackTop.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击时调用，参数为原生 click 事件；按 duration 节流，调用时滚动已开始。
onClick.en-US: Called on click with the native click event. Throttled by duration, and called once the scroll has started.

ref.zh-CN: 指向按钮 `<button>`，只在按钮显示时存在。
ref.en-US: Points to the `<button>`, which exists only while the button is visible.

shape.zh-CN: 形状，可选 `round`、`square`；未设置时为 FloatButton 的默认值 `round`。
shape.en-US: Shape: `round` or `square`. Falls back to the FloatButton default `round` when unset.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `default`、`small`、`large`；未设置时为 FloatButton 的默认值 `default`。
size.en-US: Size: `default`, `small` or `large`. Falls back to the FloatButton default `default` when unset.

style.zh-CN: 按钮的内联样式，可用于覆盖默认的位置等样式。
style.en-US: Inline style of the button, used to override its default position and other styles.

target.zh-CN: 返回被监听滚动元素的函数，未设置时为 window；返回 null 表示节点尚不可用。挂载后调用一次，此时父容器的 ref 已可读取；之后只在函数本身变化时重新调用。稳定的函数晚于挂载才返回元素时，需要重新挂载 BackTop。
target.en-US: Function returning the scrolled element, the window when unset. Returning null means the node is not available yet. Called once after mount, when the ref of a parent container is already readable, and afterwards only when the function itself changes. A stable function that returns the element only after mount needs BackTop remounted.

visibilityHeight.zh-CN: 出现 BackTop 需要达到的滚动高度。
visibilityHeight.en-US: Scroll distance after which the BackTop appears.
